title: BudgetFriend
summary: A personal expense-tracking web app with a React/Tailwind frontend and Flask backend that lets users upload CSV expense data and visualize spending via interactive charts. The backend's requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas as dependencies, but no code in the README or evidence calls any of them.
evidence: server/requirements.txt lists sdv==1.10.0, ctgan==0.9.0, rdt==1.9.2, sdmetrics==0.13.0, copulas==0.9.2; no matching usage patterns found in code
needs: No code evidence shows sdv/ctgan/rdt/sdmetrics/copulas actually invoked; dependencies may be unused or vestigial.
